configurations.name: frontend
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR=$HOME/.nvm; . $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh; cd frontend && npm run dev

configurations.name: production
runtimeArgs: cd backend && APP_ENV=production JWT_SECRET=$(python3 -c 'import secrets;print(secrets.token_hex(32))') $HOME/.local/bin/uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
